title: Cell index bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T,t\in\mathbb{N}$, $\tau<k$, and $r<2T+1$. Define the configuration stride as $k(2T+1)+N+3$ and the cell index as $t$ times this stride plus $\tau(2T+1)+r$. Then the cell index is less than $(t+1)$ times the stride.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the binary alphabet
$\tau<k$, where $k$ is the number of work tapes
